source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Ιανουάριος, Μαξίμη και Μακαρία οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is one sentence and it gives no year, no city and no emperor, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. The page heads her Μαξίμη and glosses the masculine Μάξιμος under it. Not the Maxima the corpus already keeps, who is the wife of the presbyter Montanus of Singidunum, drowned with him on the Romanian 26 March 304: that woman's place, day and companion are all different, and this company is in Africa.
